data.title: Analysis and Security-Tool Discovery
data.summary: The sample enumerates running processes and installed software for known security and analysis tools — AV/EDR agents, debuggers, network sniffers, virtualization guest tools — and adjusts its behaviour based on what it finds.
data.description:
Unlike the generic sandbox and VM checks covered elsewhere, this targets named, specific
tools: a hardcoded list of process names or installed-software entries corresponding to
particular vendors' products. The response varies by family — some simply withhold their
payload, others selectively disable or evade the specific product detected, having a
tailored response ready for each.
data.recommendation:
* Recover the hardcoded tool list; it directly indicates which security products the sample's authors specifically tested against and planned around.
* Where the response is product-specific rather than uniform withholding, test the sample against the named products individually to observe the tailored behaviour.
* Treat absence of the normally-expected security-tool processes, if removed or hidden by the sample, as a secondary indicator alongside this check.
data.short_recommendation: Recover the hardcoded security-tool list to learn which products the sample's authors specifically planned around.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Enumerated running processes against a hardcoded list of EDR and AV vendor process names and withheld payload execution on a match.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Checked installed-software and running-process lists against named security-vendor entries.
